sloka: येहि सम्भिन्न मर्यादा नास्तिकाः चिन्न सम्शयाः ।ते अपि भावाय कल्पन्ते राज दण्ड निपीडिताः ॥२-६७-३२॥
transliteration: yehi sambhinna maryādā nāstikāḥ cinna samśayāḥ ।te api bhāvāya kalpante rāja daṇḍa nipīḍitāḥ ॥2-67-32॥

translations.english: Atheists, who disregard the bounds of morality and live freely dispelling doubts will tend to follow virtuous path out of fear when subjected to royal punishment.
